# Periods and end punctuation

> **这页管什么**：句号、句间空格、和括号引号一起用时放哪。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/periods> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## General

Sentences take a period unless they're a question. Lists have their own exceptions.

## Spacing

**Leave only one space between sentences.**

## Headings

Don't end headings with periods.

## Parentheses

- If parenthetical content ends a sentence, the period goes **after** the closing parenthesis.
- If the parentheses contain a complete sentence, the period goes **inside**.

## URLs

Avoid ending a sentence with a URL so a trailing period isn't mistaken for part of the link. If unavoidable, leave no space between the URL and the period.

## Quotation marks

Periods go **inside** closing quotation marks, even if the period isn't part of the quoted material — except when quoting a literal keyword or string. If the quoted material ends in `?` or `!`, skip the period.

## Numbers

Periods mark decimal points (US convention).

## Abbreviations

Shortened words take a period; acronyms and initialisms do not.

## Exclamation points

Generally discouraged as unprofessional and poorly translatable. Concept docs avoid them entirely; tutorials may use them sparingly for milestones; code and system literals allow them when syntactically required.
